Looking for a fitness program that delivers results but still feels like personal training? Our Small Group Personal Training (SGPT) offers the perfect balance of individualised coaching in a group setting. Whether you're looking to build strength, lose fat, or improve your fitness, our small groups (up to 6 people) provide the focused attention you need to succeed.
At Evolution Fitness Studio, we know that small changes lead to big results. That’s why we’ve designed our SGPT program to give you the best of both worlds:

Looking for a fun, dynamic way to get fit while being part of a motivating community? Our Group Fitness Classes are designed to help you burn calories, build strength, and feel amazing all while having fun with others. Whether you’re new to fitness or an experienced athlete, our classes offer a supportive and high-energy environment that caters to all fitness levels.
At Evolution Fitness Studio, we believe that working out doesn’t have to be boring. Our group fitness classes are varied, energizing, and effective designed to challenge you and keep you coming back for more.

What's Included in Your 21-Day Trial Experience
Free Consultation & Full Health Assessment
We start by understanding you, your goals, challenges, lifestyle, and what success looks like. No pressure, just honest conversation at our Sheen studio.
Personalised 3-Week Strategy
our custom roadmap tailored to your fitness level, schedule, and goals. You'll know exactly what to do and why.
2-3 Expert Small Group PT Sessions Per Week
Train with experienced personal trainers in Sheen in a supportive, small group environment. Every session is personalised to you, safe, effective, and results-driven.
28-Day Evo Roadmap Guide
Your structured plan for building strength, consistency, and confidence. Clear. Simple. Actionable.
Weekly Personal Trainer Check-Ins
Your personal trainer stays connected with you throughout your trial, tracking progress, answering questions, and keeping you on track.
Daily WhatsApp Support
Got a question? Need encouragement? We're here. Real-time support when you need it most.
Basic Nutritional Guidance
Simple, sustainable nutrition advice that fits your lifestyle, no fad diets, no extremes.
End-of-Trial Health Review & 12-Month Strategy
We'll review your progress, celebrate your wins, and map out your long-term plan for continued success.

As well as being a qualified PT and spin coach, Nick (TNE) is owner and founder of Evolution.
Nick’s passion for fitness developed after battling alcoholism, addiction and overeating to realise his goal of helping others with their own physical and mental health issues. This gives Nick a unique ‘if I can, you can’ attitude that makes him ideally placed to help you recognise and realise your own fitness challenges and goals.
Nick’s non-judgmental, deeply caring, and sensitive approach means he can relate to anyone, regardless of whether you are new to fitness, scared about exercise, need some good old-fashioned motivation, or are already fit and looking to advance. Nick passionately believes in giving people the best possible tools to help become great humans and live a tip top and tidy life.
Specialising in human behaviour and change habits, whatever your goal, Nick will help you believe you can get there, even if you don't.
